build_bm25_index: build a BM25 search index from a JSON data directory using pyserini Lucene
search_bm25_documents: search the BM25 index with a query string and return top k document IDs
batch_search_bm25: batch search the BM25 index with multiple queries and return lists of document IDs
batch_search_with_task: batch search using a Task object to retrieve restricted document indices for examples
batch_search_with_dict: batch search using a precomputed dictionary of string to document ID mappings
